accused_named: Unknown Operatives posing as Chief Financial Officer

informant_narrative: The complainant states that on 08.03.2026 at about 11:30 AM, an email was received from spoofed domain instructing an urgent treasury transfer of Rs 2.5 Crores towards a Singapore container bond. Upon verification, it was found that the beneficiary accounts belonged to multiple shell mule accounts registered across State Bank of India, HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank in Jamtara, Mewat and Delhi. Subsequent communication traces indicated coordinating WhatsApp calls from virtual numbers (+919876543210 and +919811122233).
